name: Fastn Send Notification API
description:
The **Send Notification API** enables Perigon Systems to deliver signals,
events, topical reports, and curated article data into a variety of
downstream platforms using the **Fastn integration platform**.

This API is used to transmit structured content into:
- CRM platforms  
- Communication and messaging tools  
- Productivity and workflow systems  
- Any Fastn-connected enterprise application  

The API accepts structured metadata—including events, topical content,
story references, and article lists—which Fastn processes and routes
according to predefined workflows and notification rules within each
connected platform.
